name: Ahead of It · Nonprofit
intro: This test opens the app itself, not a test copy, because the purple test-copy bar covers the app’s bottom tabs. You will work with the example items, add one of your own, pick one from the library, and look at the Year and Hand-off pages.

steps.do: Tap “skip the tour” (the small underlined words at the bottom right of the welcome card).
steps.see: The card now asks “How do you want to start?” with two big choices.
steps.tip: No welcome card? You have opened this app before. Tap the round “?”, then “🎬 Take the tour again”, then “skip the tour”.

steps.do: Tap “🧪 Keep the examples to play with”.
steps.see: The card closes. Near the top a red pill says “1 overdue · 1 cost money”. The OVERDUE box holds “State charitable registration renewal (AG) (example)”, marked “3 days overdue”.
steps.tip: A green greeting strip may show at the top for a few seconds. Tap it to close it, or just wait.

steps.do: In the “DO SOMETHING NOW” box, on “Form 990 / 990-EZ / 990-N (example)”, tap “step ✓”.
steps.see: A short note says “Step done ✓”. The Form 990 item moves down into the “NEXT 90 DAYS” box.

steps.do: Scroll back up. On the overdue “State charitable registration renewal (AG) (example)”, tap “done ✓”.
steps.see: The OVERDUE box now says “Nothing overdue. That is the whole point.” and the pill at the top turns to “all clear”.

steps.do: Tap the orange round “＋” button near the bottom right.
steps.see: A form titled “Add something” opens, starting with a “What” box. “Next due” is already filled in with a date about a month from today.

steps.do: Without typing anything, scroll down in the form and tap “Save”.
steps.see: Nothing is added. A short note says “Give it a name” and the form stays open.

steps.do: Scroll back up in the form and type the example in the “What” box.
steps.see: The name appears in the box.

steps.do: Under “How bad is it if you miss this?”, tap “🔴 Costs real money”.
steps.see: “🔴 Costs real money” is now the highlighted choice (it was “🟡 A hassle”).

steps.do: In “Who else needs to know”, type the example, then tap “Save”.
steps.see: The form closes. Your item is now in the “DO SOMETHING NOW” box with “30 days out → Gather what you need”, a “🔴 costs money” tag and “tell: Pastor Dan”. (A short note “Added — the organization is watched” pops up near the bottom.)

steps.do: Tap the name of your new item.
steps.see: The form opens again, titled “Margaret O'Brien's board term renewal”, with your details filled in and a red “Delete” button at the bottom. Tap “Cancel” to close it.

steps.do: At the very bottom of the screen, tap the “📚 Library” tab.
steps.see: The Library page opens: “Tap what applies to you…”, then a list of ready-made items grouped as IRS, State, Donors, Board, Insurance and more.

steps.do: In the “Board” group, tap “Conflict-of-interest forms signed annually”.
steps.see: That button greys out and now says “· added” at the end. (A short note “Added — tap it to fix the date” also pops up near the bottom.)

steps.do: Tap “Conflict-of-interest forms signed annually” again.
steps.see: It stays greyed out with “added”, and a short note near the bottom says “Already on your list”. It is not added twice.

steps.do: Tap the “🗓 Year” tab at the bottom.
steps.see: Twelve month boxes, starting with this month. The box for about a month from now lists your “Margaret O'Brien's board term renewal” with a red dot.

steps.do: Scroll down and tap “🖨 Print the year map”.
steps.see: A print preview opens with the app name and the twelve months, each listing its items (the bottom tabs and the ＋ button are left off). Tap “Cancel” to close it.

steps.do: Tap the “🗝 Hand-off” tab at the bottom, then tap “📋 Copy hand-off summary”.
steps.see: The Hand-off page shows “📋 Copy hand-off summary” and “🖨 Print the hand-off page”. After your tap, a short note says “Copied — paste it into an email or a document”.
steps.tip: To check, you could paste it into a new note in the Notes app. It lists every item with what happens if it is missed and who to tell.

steps.do: Tap the “🧭 Next” tab, then pull the page down to reload it (or tap ↻ in Safari).
steps.see: The app comes back with everything you did: the pill says “all clear”, your “Margaret O'Brien's board term renewal” item is still there, and so is “Conflict-of-interest forms signed annually”.
steps.tip: If a “What would you like to do?” screen appears, tap “↩ Pick up where I left off”.

steps.do: Turn on Airplane Mode (swipe down from the top-right corner, tap ✈️). Tap “＋”, type the example in “What”, and tap “Save”.
steps.see: A brown strip at the top says “No connection right now — the app still works and saves on this phone.” The form closes and “Check the fire extinguishers” is on the list.

steps.do: Turn Airplane Mode off. Tap “Check the fire extinguishers”, scroll down in the form, tap the red “Delete”, and tap OK when asked “Remove this from the list?”.
steps.see: The form closes and “Check the fire extinguishers” is gone from the list. The brown strip is gone too.

steps.do: Scroll to the very top of the Next page.
steps.see: The pill says “all clear”, and the list holds your “Margaret O'Brien's board term renewal” and “Conflict-of-interest forms signed annually” along with the example items.
